name: howknowseek.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 20 pages have no title.
lesson: Give every page a unique title of about 60 characters: the page first, the site second.
summary: howknowseek.com scores 64 out of 100 (D). 8 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 24 pass. Fix first: 20 pages have no title.

fix.title: 20 pages have no title
fix.fix: Give every page a unique title of about 30 to 60 characters.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 20 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /category/auto/, /category/finance/, /category/health/ and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 335 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /wp-sitemap.xml: an unreadable URL (335). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://howknowseek.com.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 85 elements on /, /category/auto/, /category/finance/, for example #post-1460 > .byline and #post-1460 > .byline > a[href$="auto/"][rel="category tag"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 231 ms
The start page sets a mobile viewport
